I definitely don’t think Berman was perfect, but I’m generally not a fan in the direction Kurtzman is taking Trek. It strips away a lot of the things I like about TNG and other shows in the Berman era. The scripts feel all over the place, I don’t feel like I know these characters very well, and a hopeful view of the future where we all get along is out in favor for plots about war/destruction rather than interesting moral quandaries and sci-if concepts. This is small, but I also wish that Trek kept looking to the future instead of going back to the past (Enterprise included, which I do like parts of). Discovery’s place in the timeline feels less of a story that needs to be told and one to get more non-Trek fans to subscribe to CBS AA. But! Maybe Discovery will pull through! Maybe it’ll have a similar trajectory to TNG and season 3 will be amazing!
And lens focal length is also gonna depend on how big your sensor is, so 24mm is gonna mean something different on every camera.
